statements.t: Cohort expansions in patients with triple-negative breast cancer, Hodgkin lymphoma, and non-small cell lung cancer are going well for CTX-8371 and we expect to provide an update on the study later this year.

Updates from the dose-escalation study of CTX-10726 are also expected on that same timeline and we are particularly excited about the differentiated potential for CTX-10726 in the PD-1xVEGF field based on the novel mechanistic data we just presented at SITC.

The company plans to advance its product candidates through clinical development as both standalone therapies and in combination with proprietary pipeline antibodies based on supportive clinical and nonclinical data.

risks.t: Compass’s ability to raise the additional funding it will need to continue to pursue its business and product development plans
the inherent uncertainties associated with developing product candidates and operating as a development stage company
Compass’s ability to identify additional product candidates for development
obtain approvals for and commercialize any of its product candidates
competition in the industry in which Compass operates and market conditions
